title: Hohhot, Inner Mongolia — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Hohhot, Inner Mongolia: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Hohhot is a city in Inner Mongolia with a population of 3,446,000. Capital of Inner Mongolia, a city where Mongolian and Han cultures meet, known for its grasslands, dairy industry, and Buddhist temples. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4a growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
